About this map

Roads are real geometry from the October 2026 Overture Maps release (OpenStreetMap data), simplified to about 15 m. Intersections are worked out where the named roads meet, so a junction where the road data has a gap in its name may be missing.

King Salman Road is the new ring road you described: it leaves the Jeddah–Makkah Expressway before Makkah and runs in a long straight line south-west to Al Leith Road. In the map data it is still tagged as part of the Al Leith road, and about 8 km in the middle isn't mapped yet (it's under construction), so that stretch is drawn dashed. The Jeddah–Usfan road is drawn along University of Jeddah Road, which runs from north Jeddah to Usfan.

Story map trips follow the real roads: each leg is the fastest route on the October 2026 Overture/OpenStreetMap road network, between the stops in the order you told them. The roads you actually took may differ where there is more than one way; The Line is the only straight line. Spots marked "approx" or "guess" need your check. The family home is not on the map yet.
